subject: Yuno energy becomes third company to freeze prices after raising them earlier this year
posts:
Yuno Energy freezes winter prices after a May hike, joining peers in a timing game.
Evidence: May price hike, winter freeze, wholesale volatility
#Energy #Ireland

Yuno Energy announced a winter price freeze for its 100,000 customers to protect them from soaring wholesale gas costs heading into the cold months.
Stated Judgement: (+0.80, +0.50) — Greater Good

The company hiked rates significantly in May before freezing them at that inflated baseline, locking consumers into high winter costs while claiming benevolence.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.30, -0.35) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Fall into Destruction.
A corporate price freeze following a stealth summer hike exploits consumer anxiety while protecting profit margins.
Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 7.5, z: 2)

- Yuno Energy PR: FAIL (-0.6, -0.7) — Frames hikes as favors.
- Media Framing: COND (0.0, 0.0) — Repeats corporate press releases.
Yuno Energy joined Prepaypower and Electric Ireland in freezing winter rates after wholesale gas prices doubled since February amid European supply fears.

The Poison:
Freezing prices only after a hefty pre-winter rate hike means customers absorb maximum costs while the company claims PR credit for stability.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing a temporary freeze on inflated rates with actual price relief. The WHO (paying consumers) bears the burden of the May hike.

Social Physics Analysis:
Yuno runs a Smart Selfish maneuver: lock in high rates via a May hike, then posture as winter protectors when wholesale prices spike again. Pure PR extraction.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated benevolence and profit-maximizing rate hikes, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Stated altruism masks revenue protection.

The Unavoidable Truth: Energy firms lock in high baseline rates before declaring winter freezes to harvest positive PR.
The Unavoidable Lie: The freeze is an act of unselfish charity.

Alethekanon:
A winter freeze on top of a summer price hike is not consumer relief; it is financial locking. Corporations protect margins while harvesting public gratitude.

Awwthekanon:
It hurts so much to budget for winter heat, only to realize the frozen rates were pre-inflated. Families deserve honest relief, not PR stunts disguised as gifts.

Brothekanon:
Classic corporate move. Raise prices in May, then act like heroes for not raising them again in October. My gas bill isn't fooled by the PR team.

Spirithekanon:
"Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees." Isaiah 10:1 — FAIL (Deceptive Governance)
Disguising profit extraction as benevolent protection violates the trust of vulnerable households.

ELECTRICITY AND GAS provider Yuno Energy has announced a price freeze for its customers this winter, becoming the third company to do so this year.

The announcement comes after the company increased its prices in May.

Yuno Energy said the freeze would apply to its roughly 100,000 electricity and gas customers. It is the second year in a row the company has done so.

The company said it had made the decision “despite wholesale gas prices more than doubling since February to their highest level since the 2022 energy crisis, amid concerns over European gas supplies this winter”.

Energy prices have remained high following the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and have spiked again this year due to the US-Israeli war against Iran.

Margaret O’Connor, managing director of Yuno Energy, said the company is aware that energy costs are “a real concern for households, particularly heading into winter”.

“So we want to reassure customers that they won’t face price increases from us.”

Yuno Energy now joins Prepaypower and Electric Ireland, which both announced winter price freezes after raising their prices during the summer. Both energy providers had also already increased their prices before announcing their freezes.
